page.notes: Ink specks at the left margin beside lines 5 and 9 and at the right edge beside lines 3 and 15 are stains, not text. The last word is split as "perma-" / "gnum", and the line "gnum" is set right-indented as printed. Printed "eft" and "fi" are read as "est" and "si" because long s is plain s; "vfus" and "vngue" are changed to "usus" and "ungue" under the u/v rule. Printed "quo'" with its apostrophe, "eloquentiü" and "continuò" are kept as printed.
